barColor.definition: The color of every bar, unless a category gives its own: a color name or a hex code such as #0072b2.

categories.definition: The categories, drawn in the order given: at least 1 and at most 100, each with a different name.

categoryAxisLabel.definition: A label for the axis that lists the categories, as plain text. In the drawing, a label longer than two lines is cut short with “…”; the text alternative states it whole.

circumference.definition: The distance around the circle, 2π times the radius, from 0.006 to 6,283,186.

circumferenceLabelText.definition: Text shown in place of the circumference label, such as "r" or "?"; it also labels the circumference. It replaces the whole label, unit included, so add the unit to the text if it should show. An empty text is a blank label, for example a space to fill in. Text too long to fit beside the figure is placed below it, and text longer than four lines is cut short with “…”. The text alternative still states the value.

color.definition: The color of this one point, segment or bar: a color name or a hex code such as #0072b2.

diameter.definition: The distance across the circle through its center, twice the radius, from 0.002 to 2,000,000.

diameterLabelText.definition: Text shown in place of the diameter label, such as "r" or "?"; it also labels the diameter. It replaces the whole label, unit included, so add the unit to the text if it should show. An empty text is a blank label, for example a space to fill in. Text too long to fit beside the figure is placed below it, and text longer than four lines is cut short with “…”. The text alternative still states the value.

labelCircumference.definition: Whether the circumference is labeled with its measurement, next to the circle.

labelDiameter.definition: Whether the diameter is labeled with its measurement; a labeled diameter is drawn.

labelRadius.definition: Whether the radius is labeled with its measurement; a labeled radius is drawn.

lineColor.definition: The color of a line: the number line itself, a figure's outline, or one series of a line graph. A color name or a hex code such as #0072b2.

lineLabel.definition: A label for a line: the number line itself, or one series of a line graph, as plain text. In a line graph's legend, a label longer than two lines is cut short with “…”; the text alternative states it whole.

maximum.definition: The highest value on the value axis, from -1000000000 to 1000000000: 0, or at least 0.000000001 in size; above the minimum by at least a billionth of the larger end's size.

minimum.definition: The lowest value on the value axis, from -1000000000 to 1000000000: 0, or at least 0.000000001 in size.

name.definition: The category's name, as plain text, at most 200 characters. A long name wraps onto more lines; it is never cut short.

orientation.definition: Which way the categories' rows, columns or bars run: horizontal or vertical. The default depends on the graph type.

radius.definition: The distance from the center to the circle, from 0.001 to 1,000,000.

radiusLabelText.definition: Text shown in place of the radius label, such as "r" or "?"; it also labels the radius. It replaces the whole label, unit included, so add the unit to the text if it should show. An empty text is a blank label, for example a space to fill in. Text too long to fit beside the figure is placed below it, and text longer than four lines is cut short with “…”. The text alternative still states the value.

series.definition: The series, at least 1 and at most 6, each drawn as a line through one point per category. Without a lineColor, a series takes the default color for its position (the first series the first color, and so on); every series also has its own point shape and dash pattern, so series differ without color.

showCenter.definition: Whether the center is marked with a point.

showDiameter.definition: Whether the diameter is drawn through the center; it never lies on the radius.

showRadius.definition: Whether the radius is drawn, from the center horizontally to the right.

showValues.definition: Whether to write each bar's value beside it, exactly as given; a zero bar shows 0.

tickInterval.definition: The distance between neighbouring ticks on the value axis: greater than 0, dividing the scale into whole intervals, with at most 100 ticks.

title.definition: A title shown above the graph, as plain text. In the drawing, a title longer than three lines is cut short with “…”; the text alternative states it whole.

type.definition: The graph type: which kind of graph the description draws.

unit.definition: The unit of length shown after each measurement, such as cm. A unit longer than 20 characters, or with sentence punctuation, is quoted in the text alternative.

unitImage.definition: The picture every unit is drawn with, by name from the published image set.

unitValue.definition: How many units one picture stands for: greater than 0, at most 1000000000.

valueAxisLabel.definition: A label for the axis that shows the values, as plain text. In the drawing, a label longer than two lines is cut short with “…”; the text alternative states it whole.

valueScale.definition: The value axis's scale: its minimum, maximum and tick interval, each optional. A part that is given is used exactly and never extended, and must include every value; a part left out is chosen to fit the data: the minimum is zero, or lower for a line graph's negative values, and the axis ends on a tick.

valueUnitLabel.definition: What one unit of value counts, as plain text, such as "students"; the key names the picture, as in "each apple = 2 students". Left out, empty or blank, it says "units". In the drawing, a key longer than two lines is cut short with “…”; the text alternative states the label whole.

values.definition: One value per category, in the same order as the categories.

version.definition: The schema version the description is written for. Leave it out for the current version, 1.

line-graph.title: Line graph
line-graph.description: A line graph: one or more series of values over the categories, each value a point and each series a line joining its points, with a legend when there is more than one series. Each series has its own color, point shape and dash pattern. Values may be negative. At most 100 categories and 6 series.
checks: categories are given, each with a different name
one value per category in every series
every series has a different name
the value-scale tick interval is greater than 0
every series value fits the value scale

bar-graph.title: Bar graph
bar-graph.description: A bar graph: one bar per category, upright (the default) or across, its length in exact proportion to the category's value, from zero. Values are 0 or more. At most 100 categories.

valueDescriptions.vertical: Upright bars rising from the value axis, names below (the default).
valueDescriptions.horizontal: Bars across, growing to the right, names on the left.

checks: categories are given, each with a different name
one value per category
the value-scale tick interval is greater than 0
every value fits the value scale
the value scale starts at or below zero

pictograph.title: Pictograph
pictograph.description: A pictograph: one row of pictures per category (or one column, upright), each picture standing for a number of units, with a key such as "each apple = 2 students". A value that is not a whole number of pictures ends in one cropped picture. At most 100 categories and 400 pictures in all.

valueDescriptions.apple: A red apple with a short brown stem and a green leaf.
valueDescriptions.ball: A round blue ball with two curved white stripes.
valueDescriptions.book: A closed purple book seen from the front, with its pages showing at the side.
valueDescriptions.fish: An orange fish facing left, with a tail, a top fin and one dark eye.
valueDescriptions.flower: A flower with five pink petals, a yellow center and a green stem with one leaf.
valueDescriptions.person: A simple figure of a person: a round head above a rounded body, in dark grey.
valueDescriptions.tree: A tree with a brown trunk and a round green crown.

valueDescriptions.horizontal: One row of pictures per category, names on the left (the default).
valueDescriptions.vertical: One upright column of pictures per category, names below.

checks: categories are given, each with a different name
one value per category
the pictures drawn stay within the limit

circle.title: Circle
circle.description: A circle drawn to scale from its radius, diameter or circumference (give one; any other given must agree within 1%). The radius, the diameter and the center can be drawn, and each measurement labeled with its value and unit or with custom text.
checks: radius label text needs the radius labeled
diameter label text needs the diameter labeled
circumference label text needs the circumference labeled
a labeled radius is drawn
radius label text draws the radius
a labeled diameter is drawn
diameter label text draws the diameter
